dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the posterior base to the apex, indicating a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a measurable pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree posterior tilt relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Prominent convex arc with a smooth, large-radius curve fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short horizontal pixel length with high vertical thickness extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the specific pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.
